reply.thought: The first step is to retrieve the list of all orders to know which customers need payouts. I will use the list_orders tool for this.

Now that I have the list of orders, I need to calculate the net balance for each unique customer by calling net_balance(customer). The unique customers are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I will start with 'acme'.
The net balance for 'acme' is 29521 cents. Now I will get the net balance for the next customer, 'birch'.
The net balance for 'birch' is 49030 cents. Next, I will get the net balance for the last customer, 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: 'acme' (29521), 'birch' (49030), and 'cobalt' (40603). Now I must record a payout for each customer using record_payout(customer, amount_cents). I'll start with 'acme'.
Payout recorded successfully for 'acme'. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch'.
Payout recorded successfully for 'birch'. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
All payouts have been recorded successfully for all customers. I will now finalize the task by reporting the payouts made.
